PLAN "12-Week Cardiac-Safe Fitness + Nutrition with 5K Time Trial and Compound Lifts - Full Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary_strength:
    name "Improve general fitness and strength within cardiac-safe limits"
  GOAL cardiac_nutrition:
    name "Support cardiac health with balanced, low-sodium, heart-healthy nutrition"
  GOAL weight_loss:
    name "Support gradual weight loss with increased moderate-intensity aerobic work"
  GOAL 5k_time_trial:
    name "Prepare for a supervised 5K time trial under cardiac-safe limits"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full body, strength emphasis (compound focus)":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      NUTRITION:
        guidance:
          - "Daily calories: aim for a modest deficit (~250-500 kcal/day) for gradual weight loss; confirm with clinician/dietitian."
          - "Sodium: target <2000 mg/day; use herbs/spices instead of salt."
          - "Protein: aim ~1.2-1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day to support strength, unless clinician advises otherwise."
          - "Fats: prioritize mono- and polyunsaturated fats; limit saturated fat."
          - "Fiber: emphasize whole grains, legumes, fruits, and vegetables."
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Cardio + core - run-friendly":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 25m rpe 6.5 rest 0 seconds
          bird_dog 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 4x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower/upper mix with deadlift introduction":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Full body with compound lifts":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..75s rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      NUTRITION:
        guidance:
          - "Breakfast: oatmeal with berries, ground flaxseed, nuts, and a protein source (Greek yogurt or protein powder)."
          - "Lunch: salad with mixed vegetables, grilled fish or legumes, quinoa, olive oil and lemon."
          - "Dinner: baked fish or skinless poultry, steamed vegetables, and whole grains or sweet potato."
          - "Snacks: fresh fruit, unsalted nuts, raw vegetables with hummus."
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Run-friendly steady cardio":

          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 30m rpe 6.5..7 rest 0 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:

          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:

          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds

    WEEK 3:

        main straight_sets:
          cycling 5m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          cycling 3x(4m rpe 7 rest 2m rpe 5) rpe 7..7.5 rest 120 seconds
          cycling 6m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 70m "Posterior chain & strength balance":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:

          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:

    WEEK 5:

        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Maintain loads - strength (lighter pre-race)":

          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x75s rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

          - "Reinforce habits: maintain low-sodium, fiber-rich, nutrient-dense meals; continue regular monitoring and follow-up with healthcare team."
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Tapered intervals & race prep":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 8m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          running 4x(3m rpe 7..7.5 rest 3m walking rpe 4) rpe 7..7.5 rest 180 seconds
          running 8m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      NUTRITION:
        guidance:
          - "Pre-trial: light carbohydrate-rich snack 1-2 hours prior (e.g., banana with small yogurt); hydrate but avoid overdrinking."
          - "Post-trial: protein + carbohydrate within 60 minutes to support recovery."
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Light strength & mobility - pre-race":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Taper week - easy maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x60s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      NUTRITION:
        guidance:
          - "Race-week: maintain normal diet; prioritize carbohydrates 48 hours pre-trial, avoid large fatty meals, and keep sodium moderate per clinician guidance."
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Pre-trial easy run":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          running 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Friday training 30m "5K Time Trial (supervised)":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 30m rpe 6..8 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      NUTRITION:
        guidance:
          - "Ensure clinician clearance for a time trial. Keep heart rate below 70% age-predicted max (~115 bpm) unless cleared otherwise; stop if symptoms occur."
          - "Use a moderate carbohydrate snack 1-2 hours before if tolerated and hydrate appropriately."
